subject.title: Inject sibling agent list into session system prompt

question: Should sibling-agent roster metadata and agent-to-agent permission state be exposed through a gated discovery tool, injected into every session prompt, or deferred until a broader roster contract is designed?
rationale: The missing behavior is source-proven, but exposing peer identities, roles, and permission topology to model-visible context is a product and security-boundary choice that code inspection cannot safely decide.

options.title: Prefer Gated Tool Discovery
options.body: Expose only allowed peer metadata through agents_list or a similar explicit tool response, with permission-aware output and tests for disclosure limits.

options.title: Inject Prompt Roster
options.body: Add a minimal sibling roster to the system prompt, accepting that every eligible session receives this topology without an explicit tool call.

options.title: Defer For Broader Roster Design
options.body: Wait for the description, Matrix mention, identity, and session-routing work to converge on one roster/access contract before implementing this issue.

recommendation.title: Prefer Gated Tool Discovery
recommendation.body: Expose only allowed peer metadata through agents_list or a similar explicit tool response, with permission-aware output and tests for disclosure limits.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced agents_list and has the strongest current feature-history signal for the agent discovery boundary.
